name: Indiana

agency.name: Indiana Department of Natural Resources, Division of Reclamation (Oil and Gas Program; formerly Division of Oil and Gas)

form.name: Application for Well Permit (Form A1)
form.notes: Fillable 6-page PDF read in full. Part I general (operator, applicant type, bond, well type, application type, fee), II surface location and lease, III casing and cement, IVa-d drilling info by well type, V diagram (Class II only), VI affirmation, VII survey plat. Fee $250 ($750 expedited); no BOP, H2S, pit, water or frac sections. Page also lists forms for transfers, test holes, temporary abandonment, fluid storage.

api_number.n: No API field on the form, in the layer or in the weekly PDF; IGS ID and permit number are the keys

operator_name.n: operator_name in layer 0; individuals can be operators

operator_id.n: Form asks name only (as on the Organizational Report); no operator number field

operator_type.n: Applicant is: individual, partnership, corporation, LLC, LP, public corp.

bond.n: Type of bond (surety, blanket, CD, personal surety, none required)

district.n: No district or region on the form or in the layer

field_pool.n: Pool name or Wildcat on form; shown in weekly 'Permits Issued' PDF, not a layer field

surface_latlon.n: Point geometry plus Utmx/Utmy; 'method' column says how it was located

surface_plss.n: township, range, direction, land_type, land_number; footages only on form/PDF

bottom_hole_loc.n: Horizontal/directional only: UTMs of kickoff, entry, termination (instructions)

lateral_path.n: Directional and horizontal wells: proposed directional survey attached

elevation.n: Elevation (G.L.) on form; printed in weekly 'Permits Issued' PDF, not a layer field

surface_owner.n: Name of surface owner; notice of intent to survey to owner

well_type.n: CompType in Completion table (oil, gas, ER, SWD...); permit-time type in weekly PDF

work_type.n: Form: new, workover, deepening, sidetrack, conversion; PDF shows it. Completion ReportType differs

proposed_depth_md.n: 'Proposed measured length', horizontal wells only; may mean lateral length

proposed_depth_tvd.n: Form: proposed TVD, all wells; weekly PDF prints 'estimated depth'

lateral_length.n: Form's 'proposed measured length' (horizontal) is ambiguous: lateral or total

target_formation.n: Deepest formation to be drilled; printed in weekly 'Permits Issued' PDF

formation_tops.n: Class II wells only: confining and injection zone names and intervals

casing_program.n: Part III casing sizes, depths, hole sizes

cement_program.n: Part III cement type, volume, yield

pressure_control.n: No BOP or pressure-control item on the form

h2s.n: No H2S item on the form

pit_waste.n: No pit or drilling-waste item on the form

water.n: Only non-potable water-supply wells give a withdrawal rate; no drilling-water item

fracture_plan.n: No frac plan on form; layer has a HydroFrac flag and frac reports are filed later

frac_dates.n: Scanned Hydraulic Fracturing Report (date stimulated) is posted per well; scans only, not in the data tables

frac_chemicals.n: Report names products, not chemicals; the agency posts product safety data sheets, not a chemical list per well

frac_additives.n: Scanned report lists each product's name, type and maker per well; scans only, not in the data tables

frac_amounts.n: Scanned report gives each product's rate or concentration, not each chemical's; scans only

spacing_unit.n: Drilling unit acreage 5/10/20/40 ac, pooled or waterflood unit

spacing_exception.n: 'Other acres' with exception petition; image type 'Spacing Exceptions' listed

mineral_owner.n: Does operator control the drilling rights in the unit; if no, state basis

notice_hearing.n: Survey notice to surface owner; coal mine and storage-field operator notices

date_received.n: 'Date received' in the state-use box; not in layer or PDF

date_approved.n: Issue date printed per permit in weekly 'Permits Issued' PDF (2020 on); not in layer

date_expires.n: No expiry field seen; status values include Expired

spud_date.n: Not asked on the form and no spud column in layer; daily drilling reports are images

completion_date.n: CompDate and ReportedDate in Completion table

status.n: status in layer 0: Active, Drilling, Expired, Revoked, Cancelled, Plugged, TA...

form_image.n: DOG_Image_FileList: Description 'Application' and 'Permit Certificate' with URL

completion_report.n: DOG_Image_FileList: 'Completion Report', frac and well rework reports with URL

logs.n: DOG_Image_FileList: many log types (PDF, TIF, IFF) with URL

production_link.n: Monthly report gives statewide oil/gas totals only; per-well link not verified

sources.name: Indiana Geological and Water Survey Petroleum Database (PDMS), legacy site
sources.tested: One GET: connection reset through the proxy (tunnel closed). Not retried. A search snippet says it holds ~83,000 wells with ASCII table download; unverified.

grade_reason: A free, reachable ArcGIS API gives one row per well with permit number, status, operator, lease, county, PLSS and point location, plus a completion table (CompDate, CompType, ReportType). But no permit approval or spud date is in any bulk source. Approval dates (and work type, depth, pool) exist only in the weekly and monthly PDFs, which are text-extractable but not machine-readable data. Indiana is tiny (about 5 permits in May 2026, 1 in the week of Oct 23).
producer_plan: Two-part. (1) Permits by month: download the weekly 'Permits Issued' PDFs (index page lists them back to 2020; one polite fetch per week, a few hundred files, then only new weeks), run pdftotext, and split on the fixed sentence 'was issued a(n) <type> permit on <date>'; read type (Oil, Gas, Non-Commercial Gas, Class II...), date, permit number, county, application type (New, Deepening, Workover...), direction, pool and depth. Count by month and by type. Check against the monthly report's per-county 'permits issued' totals. (2) Wells and status: query OilAndGasWells layer 0 (resultOffset paging, 2000 per page, returnGeometry optional) for status and location, and the Completion table (layer 2) for completions by month (CompDate) and CompType; join on IGS_ID, permit number from layer 0. Do not publish operator names that are individuals (many Indiana operators are); apply the corporation/LLC/LP rule. Caveats: PDF wording could change; counts are tiny so noise is high; the layer has no approval date, so it cannot rebuild history by itself.
privacy_notes: The weekly and monthly PDFs print each operator's name, street address and phone, and many operators and surface owners are individuals; the layer's operator_name column and the scanned documents can name individuals. List and publish only counts, place-level data and corporate/LLC/LP operator names. No personal data copied here.
